examples.ask.attr.000:
You are helping build practice sentences for a very small language model.

Rewrite the SENTENCE below in 8 different ways that a person might really say. Keep the
meaning exactly the same.

Hard rules:
- Keep every placeholder exactly as written and use each one exactly once: {OWNER}, {R}.
- Never replace a placeholder with a real word, a name, or an example.
- Never add a new placeholder.
- Use simple words a seven-year-old knows. One short sentence each. All lower case.
- Do not explain. Output one rewrite per line and nothing else.

The placeholders mean:
- {OWNER} is a person's name; it is hidden from you on purpose
- {R} is the kind of belonging being talked about

SENTENCE: what is {OWNER}'s {R}?

paraphrase_prompt:
You are helping build practice sentences for a very small language model.

Rewrite the SENTENCE below in {n} different ways that a person might really say. Keep the
meaning exactly the same.

Hard rules:
- Keep every placeholder exactly as written and use each one exactly once: {slots}.
- Never replace a placeholder with a real word, a name, or an example.
- Never add a new placeholder.
- Use simple words a seven-year-old knows. One short sentence each. All lower case.
- Do not explain. Output one rewrite per line and nothing else.

The placeholders mean:
{meanings}

SENTENCE: {template}

slot_meanings.{O2}: {O2} is another person's name; it is hidden from you on purpose
slot_meanings.{OLD}: {OLD} is the wrong answer that is being replaced
slot_meanings.{OWNER_OF}: {OWNER_OF} is a person's name; it is hidden from you on purpose
slot_meanings.{OWNER}: {OWNER} is a person's name; it is hidden from you on purpose
slot_meanings.{O}: {O} is a second person's name; it is hidden from you on purpose
slot_meanings.{R2}: {R2} is a second kind of belonging
slot_meanings.{R}: {R} is the kind of belonging being talked about

checks: placeholders present exactly once and none added
no literal name, value or relation word leaked into a slot
the reference parser recovers the same act, subject, relation path, object and old value on six random fillings
a yes/no Qwen check that B says exactly the fact A says
verifier.on_failure: the paraphrase is dropped, never repaired
